title: WhatsApp Business Platform Pricing | WhatsApp API Pricing

facts.fact: WhatsApp Business Platform says messages sent within 72 hours after a customer messages from a Click-to-WhatsApp ad or Facebook Page call-to-action button are not charged.
facts.quote: for the following 3 days (72 hours), all of your messages are not charged.

facts.fact: WhatsApp Business Platform states it does not charge for service messages, or for utility messages businesses send in response to users.
facts.quote: we **do not charge** for service messages, or for utility messages businesses send in response to users.

facts.fact: WhatsApp Business Platform states it charges when a message is delivered, not when it is sent.
facts.quote: We charge when a message is **delivered** (not sent).

facts.fact: WhatsApp Business Platform lists four message categories: marketing, utility, authentication, and service.
facts.quote: There are four message categories on the WhatsApp Business Platform: marketing, utility, authentication, and service.

facts.fact: WhatsApp Business Platform states that when a user messages a business, a 24-hour customer service window opens, and the window resets with each user message.
facts.quote: this opens a 24-hour customer service window during which businesses can respond with service messages.

facts.fact: WhatsApp Business Platform states that its rates vary by market and message category pair and that it publishes its rates.
facts.quote: Our rates **vary by market – category pair**, and we [**publish our rates for transparency**]

facts.fact: WhatsApp Business Platform states that volume tiers for utility and authentication messages unlock more attractive pricing as businesses send more messages.
facts.quote: Volume tiers for utility and authentication messages enable businesses to unlock more attractive pricing as they grow on our platform.

facts.fact: WhatsApp Business Platform states that volume tier rates apply only to the messages within each tier.
facts.quote: Rates are specific to the messages in a tier, so only apply to the messages in that tier.

facts.fact: WhatsApp Business Platform describes utility messages as typically triggered by a user action, such as placing an order or submitting a payment, and not promotional.
facts.quote: Utility messages are typically triggered by a user action, like placing an order or submitting a payment. These messages are not promotional

facts.fact: WhatsApp Business Platform describes authentication messages as enabling businesses to use one-time passwords (OTPs) for identity verification.
facts.quote: Authentication messages enable businesses to use one-time passwords (OTPs) for identity verification, potentially at multiple stages of the user journey.
